game_concept: A arcade set in Coastal Port – Tidepool Cove, a tidepool cove: the dock cartographer must handle kraken tentacles while practicing conditionals (if / elif / else). Core idea – Priority Alert: Order elif checks correctly because only the first true branch runs.
theme: Coastal Port – Tidepool Cove: a tidepool cove
core_gameplay_loop: In Tidepool Cove, repeat each round: Order elif checks correctly because only the first true branch runs. Each round, a new anchors challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the alert_accuracy value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Collect 100 points of anchors by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 100, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 3 – Conditionals (if / elif / else) | Level 1 (intro tier): Priority Alert
assets_style: pixel-art harbor town: deep blue sea, wooden docks, orange-roofed buildings, sailing ships; flat Kenney-style sprites; sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Priority Alert' (Week 3 slot 13), mission type 'Resource Rush', and setting 'Tidepool Cove'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Coastal Port
region.mood: sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how alert_accuracy changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against kraken tentacles in Tidepool Cove.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: score >= 100 within 30 seconds.
